in_sanskrit.name: Bisho
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Bringer of Joy
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bisho एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Bisho is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vishwa' which means 'all' or 'universal'. The name Bisho is a term of endearment for a child who is believed to bring joy and light to the lives of those around them.
